items.summary: arXiv:2610.10356v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper extends Goodwin's (1967) predator-prey growth-cycle model to incorporate the negative impact of Opioid Use Disorder (OUD) on labor productivity. items.summary: arXiv:2411.08720v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: I show that outsourced cryptocurrency wash trading is shaped by the objective assigned to the outside firm.
